question: When iron nails come in contact with copper sulphate solution their colour changes to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**brown**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When** iron nails come in contact with copper sulphate solution, their color changes to brown**
 
• The iron nail **develops a brown copper coating, and the blue color of the copper sulfate solution fades.**
 
• This is because iron is **more reactive than copper, so it displaces the copper from the copper sulfate.**
 
• The iron is **dissolved in the solution as Fe (II), producing ferrous sulfate FeSO4, which is greenish blue**.
 
• The copper also displaces deposits around the nail, giving it a reddish brown color.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Metal activity series:​

 
• The metals are arranged in an activity order that is known as metal activity series.
 
• The more active metals are present at the top of the series whereas the less active metals are put at the end of the series.
 
• The metal activity series is as follows- 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f72c7124c6f6b6df6ff803bb9d21ff32167392bfbf97526a2b34b5f710d4b56.png] ​

 
• The metal activity series is used to predict displacement reactions.
